name: Sheet-pan dinner
intro: One vegetable, one protein, one pan, a hot oven, and the jar after. The shape you'll make most this month.
season_anchor: Kabocha wedges, or sweet potato in cubes

variations.context: The October version. Everything goes in together.

variations.ingredients: Chicken sausage + sweet potato + peppers + lemon
variations.context: When the kabocha's gone. Same pan, same timing.
The sausage is gone. The egg goes on at the table.

finish: Heat the oven to 425°F. Squash, peppers, and sausage go on one pan together, oiled and salted, with room between the pieces. Roast about 30 minutes, turning the sausages once, until they're browned and the squash edges are dark. Ajvar and a squeeze of lemon over everything at the table.
